messages:
Asha R: quick sync 1: integrator asked for a one-file observability pack (Datadog + OTEL) for our HW listing. need a concise install + QA checklist by EOD.
Ben T: list the must-haves?
Asha R: minimal OTEL collector config, span attribute guidance, a short dashboard JSON, runbook bullets (rotate/retention), and a demo link. also a note about cardinality.
Clara M: span attrs they want: model_family, model_id, batch_size, quant_hint. quant_hint should be conditional to avoid cardinality.
Diego F: proposal: emit quant_hint only when != "fp16" and include coarse tag quant_class for indexing. batch_size as int attr. add model_family as resource attr.
Ben T: sampling: integrator wants baseline ~5% and full capture for errors + latency > 450ms. OTEL tail_sampling covers it. i'll paste a tiny snippet for docs.
Ben T: ```
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
processors:
  tail_sampling:
    policies:
      - name: errors
        type: string_attribute
        string_attribute:
          key: "error"
          values: ["true"]
      - name: slow_traces
        type: latency
        latency:
          threshold_ms: 450
exporters:
  datadog:
    api_key: ${DD_API_KEY}
```
Clara M: include guidance to index dd.trace_id in logs and index model_family not model_id to control costs.
Asha R: dashboard naming suggestion: `Integrations / <Partner> / Model / <model_family> / Inference` so tiles are consistent in the marketplace.
Diego F: runbook bullets: logrotate sample, retention: traces 7d, metrics 30d, and fallback to metric-only when high-card spans surface. warn about collector disk under high sampling.
